context: We can now formally state the open problem: Open Problem 1 Given any hypothesis class H ⊆ [0, 1]X that has finite (γ, k)-fat shattering dimension for all γ, can we construct a list hypothesis class Hlist ⊆ ([0, 1]k )X satisfying the following properties? • Hlist contains H: namely, for every h ∈ H, there exists hlist ∈ Hlist satisfying h ≺ hlist . • Hlist has finite dimension: namely, flatten(Hlist ) has finite (γ, k)-fat-shattering dimension for all γ.
